text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a young patient with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions. To understand what is causing this, how many skin lesions do you have and where are they located on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme disease (Borrelia burgdorferi infection). The history of recent camping in Minnesota, followed by self-resolving monoarthritis (likely the knee) and now fever with wrist pain and skin lesions is highly characteristic.
